connectionRequiresConsent: This client will need fresh authorization to reconnect.
readyForRead: Read access is granted. Run a read in this client to check provider access.
remoteOwnerHelp: Add a passkey for the remote site to this same owner. Your existing passkeys stay available. The setup link expires in five minutes.
remoteOwnerConfirm: Create a one-use link to add a remote passkey for this owner?
serviceSummary: Mail and Calendar share this credential.
freshnessFailed: Could not refresh this snapshot. Last observations remain below; retry to check current state.
connectionReviewAgain: Connection state changed or this update could not be completed. Refresh diagnostics and review again; this attempt did not change grants.
capabilityUpgradeHelp: This updates the permissions this SAME MCP connection can request. Existing tokens, consent and account access stay unchanged. Next, refresh this connection in ChatGPT and explicitly approve the new permissions.
capabilityUpgradeComplete: Available permissions updated. Refresh the SAME MCP connection in ChatGPT, then approve the new permissions. Existing grants are unchanged.
connectionImpactHelp: This affects all grants for this client. It leaves stored iCloud credentials and other clients unchanged.
pollingPaused: Automatic refresh paused. Refresh when you need current status.
registeredMetadata: Registration metadata does not identify a person or prove consent.
staleStatus: This snapshot is over one minute old. Refresh before relying on current state.
accountExists: This account is already saved. Use Accounts to maintain its credential.
credentialChanged: Credential state changed while checking. Refresh and retry.
overviewEvidence: Open Client connections for account-bound read evidence and timestamps.
accountHealthUnknown: A stored credential is not a current provider health check. Inspect client read evidence.
clientEvidenceHelp: Select this client below to inspect account-bound evidence.
externalUnknown: Unknown. A configured public route does not prove an external MCP request succeeded.
supervisionUnknown: Unknown. This check did not verify a LaunchAgent supervising this process.
logsUnavailable: Unavailable in this view. Raw logs and sensitive inventory are excluded.
savedAccountRequired: Save an account credential before continuing.
discardNavigation: Discard unsaved changes and leave this page?
adminScopeNote: Private administration. The supported release workflow is one iCloud account with one custom MCP connection.
statusLoading: Status not yet checked. Loading current observations…
systemHelp: Unknown means this check has no reliable observation. Refresh to check routing and runtime details.
installationPolicyHelp: Choose what this service permits across all accounts. Each connection still needs its own consent.
connectionsHelp: Review each connection’s account and allowed actions. Removing a connection does not delete its iCloud account.
accountWizardHelp: Mail and Calendar use the same iCloud app-specific password. Client permissions are approved separately when connecting.
observedHelp: These timestamps describe this account and client only. Keep using the existing connection; refresh diagnostics if access changes. They do not prove future access or other permissions.
authorizationObserved: Read permission observed on an authenticated request at
calendarListObserved: Calendar list passed; event read still needed. Listed at
readinessHelp: Inspect the selected account and client. Successful reads have their own timestamps.
unknownAuthorization: Unknown — account/client grant evidence is unavailable here
recoverySelect: Select an account and client to see registration recovery guidance.
recoveryNew: Keep this MCP connection. Its available permissions cannot be upgraded safely from the current registration evidence. Refresh connection diagnostics and contact the installation owner; no grant has changed.
recoveryOwner: In Connections, review and confirm this client's new available permissions. Then refresh the SAME MCP connection in ChatGPT and explicitly consent. No new MCP or app password is required.
recoveryConsent: This registration allows read permission. That is not a grant. Refresh the host tool catalog and explicitly authorize any missing read permission in ChatGPT, then perform a read.
recoveryUnavailable: Client diagnostics could not be loaded. Authorization and test status remain unknown. Retry diagnostics or sign in again; no permissions were changed.
readinessTestHelp: In the selected client, list mailboxes; for Calendar, list calendars and query an event; for Photos, list albums or query assets. Photos reads the selected library on the service Mac. Seeing tools or passing a health check is not a successful provider read. Observations expire and a restart clears them.
unsavedPolicy: Unsaved selection — saved readiness below has not changed.
calendarAllHelp: For read-only access, select Read calendars only.
readinessCredentialMissing: This account has no stored credential. Reconnect it through ChatGPT before testing.
accountAddHelp: To add an account, open this plugin in ChatGPT Settings and choose Connect another account.
pluginDownloadHelp: This package uses this installation’s configured public endpoint. Import it using a supported private plugin workflow and authorize access, or follow the manual setup below. Downloading does not install or verify a connection.
calendarDependencies: Calendar editing requires read access. Invitations and sharing require both read and edit access. Review the Calendar selection before saving.
maintenanceHelp: Use this section to replace an app-specific password or remove stored credentials. Add accounts with the setup wizard; authorize client permissions separately in ChatGPT.
policyPartial: Some settings may have been saved. The current saved settings have been reloaded; review them before trying again.
policyUnknown: Could not reload saved settings. Reload this page before trying again.
moduleNote: Validate the stored iCloud credential before enabling capabilities. Clients need separate consent.
photosPermissions: Photos permissions on the service Mac
photosLibraryContext: Selected library on the service Mac
photosDependencies: Photos changes require read access. Deletion also requires editing access.
photosPolicyHelp: Uses the selected library on the service Mac. Write and delete actions also require enabling them in the service configuration.
policyConfirm: Enabling capabilities lets clients request those permissions. Existing OAuth grants remain unchanged. Enable the selected capabilities?
policyNote: New permissions need explicit client consent. Existing grants remain unchanged.
policyManaged: Capability settings are managed in the service configuration.
replaceNote: Select an account to update its app-specific password. Its address and existing connection remain unchanged; saved passwords are never shown.
iconHelp: 256 × 256 PNG, under 10 KB. Upload this file in the optional Icon field.
developerInstructions: Open **Settings** → **Security and login** → **Developer mode** and enable it. Your plan and workspace permissions must allow custom MCP connections.
openInstructions: Use ChatGPT in a web browser for this setup, rather than the desktop or mobile app. Sign in, then open **ChatGPT Plugins**.
submitInstructions: Read **I understand and want to continue** and select the acknowledgment only if you agree. Then click **Create as a plugin**.
connectIntro: Your iCloud setup is complete. Follow these steps to connect ChatGPT; this page does not verify the assistant connection.
endpointPrerequisite: Before creating the connection, the service operator must enable and verify the public MCP/OAuth endpoint. The address below is configured, not a readiness check. The private setup address is for administration only.
chatgptPath: Open **Create custom MCP server** in ChatGPT Plugins. Enter the fields below. Icon is optional. Under **Connection**, select **Server URL**, not Tunnel, for this service. Availability depends on your plan and workspace policy.
appDescription: Connect your AI assistant to iCloud.
copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the field and copy it manually.
urlMissing: Public MCP URL is not configured. Contact the service operator.
oauthInstructions: Under **Authentication**, select **OAuth**. Once automatic discovery succeeds, **Advanced OAuth settings** can remain collapsed. If discovery fails, ask the service operator to verify public MCP/OAuth reachability, then retry discovery. Do not invent manual client credentials or enter your Apple password in this dialog.
authorizeInstructions: Use your **iCloud Plugin Admin Passkey**, select an existing iCloud account or add one with its email and app-specific password, then approve access. Later, use **Connect another account** in this plugin’s ChatGPT settings to add more accounts.
safePrompt: List my 5 most recent emails with sender, subject, and date. Do not change their read/unread state or make any other mailbox changes.
promptInstructions: In a new ChatGPT conversation, select the connected plugin from the **tools menu** and paste this prompt. If it is unavailable, finish authorization or check workspace permissions.
sessionExpired: Your setup session expired. Continue from the owner step to renew it, then try finishing setup again.
introSetup: A few steps to set up your private connection.
introAdmin: Manage accounts, service capabilities and credentials over your private connection.
connectionIntro: Setup and administration use your private Tailscale network. These checks describe the computer running the service.
downloadHelp: Open Tailscale, sign in to the same private network, and make sure the service computer is connected.
ownerIntro: Use Touch ID, Face ID, or your device unlock to create your personal sign-in.
ownerNote: Setup starts only from an approved private connection. Follow your device’s prompt to create a passkey.
existingPasskey: This browser has already registered a passkey. Continue to finish owner setup.
ownerDenied: This connection is not authorized to set up the owner. Open the private service from the approved Tailscale account, then check again.
mailIntro: Mail and Calendar use your stored iCloud credential. Use an Apple app-specific password, not your regular Apple Account password.
appleGuide: How to create an app-specific password ↗
appleGuideHelp: Follow Apple’s official instructions, then return here to continue.
passwordHelp: We verify the mail connection before saving. Your password is not kept in browser storage.
revokeIntro: Remove the mail credentials stored by this service. This does not delete mail or revoke your Apple password or client grants.
revokeConfirm: Remove these credentials? Your assistant will lose mailbox access through this service until you reconnect.
doneIntro: Your owner account and credentials are saved. Mail is currently supported; your assistant still needs its own connection and authorization.
doneNote: Finishing setup does not automatically enable the public OAuth endpoint or install a ChatGPT or Codex connection.
codexHelp: 1. Prepare the service’s MCP/OAuth address for your chosen assistant. The private setup address is not the connector URL. This page does not activate public access.
chatgptHelp: 2. In Codex, add the configured remote MCP service or generated plugin. In ChatGPT, use an eligible account’s custom MCP connection. Use the service’s /icloud/mcp URL and sign in with your owner Passkey.
testHelp: 3. Ask your assistant to list your mail folders. Approve the connection when prompted. You can rotate or remove stored credentials using Manage connection below.
noScript: This page requires JavaScript. Enable it and reload.
retry: The action did not complete. Please try again.
providerError: Could not sign in to iCloud Mail. Check your email address and app-specific password, then try again.
prerequisiteError: Your private connection is not ready. Go back to Connection and check Tailscale sign-in and connectivity.
closedError: This service is already set up. Sign in on the management page.
ownerError: Your session expired or does not belong to this service’s owner. Sign in again.
originError: This page is not on the configured private service address. Reopen the original private URL.
inputError: Enter your email address and app-specific password.
networkError: Connection interrupted. Check your private network and try again.
actionError: The action did not complete. Check your sign-in and private connection, then try again.
checkError: Could not check connectivity. Use the private service URL and select Check again.
statusError: Could not read connection status. Please try again shortly.
missingInstall: Tailscale was not detected on the service computer. Install it, or check that the service can use the Tailscale command.
missingLogin: Open Tailscale on the service computer and sign in to your private network.
missingOnline: The service computer is offline. Connect Tailscale and check again.
missingPrivate: The private service cannot be reached. Check the private URL and Tailscale Serve configuration.
connectionReady: Your private connection is ready. You can continue.
connectionNotReady: Follow the guidance above, then check again.
passkeyError: Passkey setup did not complete. Use an approved private connection and finish the device prompt. If you cancelled it, you can try again.
passkeyLoading: Follow your device’s prompt to create a passkey…
emailInvalid: Enter a valid iCloud email address.
revoked: Local mail credentials removed. Revoke your Apple app-specific password and client grants separately if needed.
missingInput: The form could not load. Reload this page.
auth_connectionExpired: This connection request cannot continue. Return to ChatGPT and choose Connect another account to start a new request.
auth_savedReconnect: The account is saved. Return to ChatGPT, choose Connect another account, and select this account to finish authorization.
auth_introConnect: Connect an existing account or add another iCloud account. Each connection uses the account you select.
auth_passwordHelp: Use an Apple app-specific password. It is verified and stored securely by this service; it is never sent to ChatGPT.
auth_providerError: Could not sign in to iCloud Mail. Check the email and app-specific password, then try again.
auth_duplicateAccount: This account already exists. Select it above, or update its password on the private management page.
auth_accountUnavailable: The selected account has no stored credentials. Update its password on the private management page.
auth_chooseAccount: Choose an account before approving access.
auth_introConsent: Choose what this connection can do. Unchecked actions will not be granted.
auth_selectPermission: Choose at least one permission, or deny the connection.
auth_photosLibrary: Photos uses the selected library on the Mac running this service. Your iCloud app-specific password connects Mail and Calendar only.
auth_scopePhotosRead: Read photos, previews, existing people labels and albums in the selected Mac Photos library
auth_scopePhotosWrite: Apply explicitly reviewed ordinary-album and metadata changes; remote Shared Album posting is currently unavailable
auth_scopePhotosDelete: Delete specifically reviewed photos from the synced library; deletion can affect other synced devices
auth_introSignIn: Use the passkey you created during setup.
auth_requestFailed: The request failed. Try again or restart the connection.
auth_incompleteConnection: The connection request is incomplete. Reconnect from your client.
auth_signedIn: Signed in. Return to your client to continue.
auth_incompleteAuthorization: The authorization response is incomplete. Reconnect.
auth_actionFailed: The request did not complete. Try again. Cancelling the passkey prompt does not grant access.
auth_scopeSend: Send new messages and replies from your iCloud mailbox
auth_scopeWrite: Change message state and organize your mailbox
auth_scopeOffline: Continue using this connection when you are offline
photosPermissionReady: Library read and Photos access are ready. Automation may still be requested for metadata edits.
photosLibraryUnavailable: The selected library is unavailable. Check library setup and Full Disk Access, then restart the host app.
photosPermissionOpened: Opened on the service Mac. Allow access there, then check permissions again.
photosPermissionFailed: Could not check or open permissions. Sign in as owner and verify the helper is installed.
photosAuthorization_not_requested: Request Photos access, then choose full access.
photosAuthorization_denied: Photos access is denied. Open Photos Privacy Settings to allow it.
photosAuthorization_limited: Limited Photos access is insufficient. Choose full access.
photosAuthorization_restricted: Photos access is restricted by system policy.
photosAuthorization_unavailable: Photos helper is unavailable. Complete helper setup.
photosSetupHelp: Complete these permissions on the Mac running this service. Opening settings does not change any photos.
photosLibraryHelp: Allow Full Disk Access for the app running this service. If you change it, quit and reopen that app.
photosAuthorizationHelp: Choose full access for iCloud Photos Helper. If it is not listed yet, request access first.
photosVerificationHelp: After completing the Mac prompts, check again. Continue when both library reading and Photos access are ready.
photosMetadataHelp: Photos may also ask for Automation access when you edit titles or keywords. Allow control of Photos. These links open settings on the device viewing this page; the buttons above open them on the service Mac.
photosCloudHelp: Use your existing account and MCP connection. Mail and Calendar use an app-specific password; Mac-local Photos uses the Mac's Photos permissions. This experimental web route requires an additional Apple Account sign-in with two-factor authentication. Shared Album writes are still in development.
photosCloudPrivacy: Your Apple Account password and verification code are used only for this request and are not stored. No photos or invitations are sent by signing in.
photosCloudSetup: Set up experimental Shared Album access
photosCloudConfirm: Confirm disconnecting this account's Shared Album API session
photosCloudNeedSetup: Set up the connection before signing in.
photosCloudAuthenticated: Signed in. Shared Album operations have not yet been verified.
photosCloudChoose: Select an account and sign in.
photosCloudWorking: Setting up the connection on the service.
photosCloudFailed: Could not complete the connection request. Check the account and try an explicit new request.
photosCloudUnsupported: This authentication method is not supported yet.
photosCloudNewRequest: Apple authentication needs a new explicit sign-in or code request.
photosVerification_sms: This sign-in requested an SMS code. Enter the latest code from Apple's text message, not a code from a Mac or iPhone pop-up.
photosVerification_trusted_device: Enter the code from the trusted-device prompt for this sign-in.
photosVerification_security_key: This sign-in requires a security key; six-digit code verification is not available.
photosVerification_unknown: The verification source is unknown. Request a new code before entering one.
photosVerificationFailed: Apple did not accept this verification code.
photosMetadataDetails: Metadata editing permissions and manual settings links
requirementsMissing: Complete the missing requirements before enabling capabilities.
tailscaleSetupHelp: Install Tailscale on the service Mac, sign in to the approved network, and configure the private route. These instructions do not change routes automatically.
ownerSetupHelp: Create or resume the installation owner passkey. This requirement is independent of iCloud credentials.
moduleConfirm: Confirm enabling these capabilities. Existing client grants stay unchanged.
capabilitiesDisabledDefault: New installations start with every capability disabled. Enable only the modules and scopes you need.
credentialModalHelp: App passwords connect Mail and Calendar. The password is cleared after this request and is not kept in browser storage.
webSessionHelp: This is the existing Shared Album web session, not proof of Mail, Calendar or live provider access. Your Apple Account password is used only for this request.
noAccountYet: Add an iCloud account to configure credentials and client connections.
requirementsFailed: A requirement could not be verified. Refresh or complete setup before enabling.
resetSummary: Choose what to reset. Each option requires confirmation.
resetConnectionsHelp: Remove stored accounts, app passwords, Apple web sessions, app login sessions, client registrations and grants, module settings and operation history. Owner identity, Passkeys and master key remain.
resetFactoryHelp: Remove all application accounts, sessions, client registrations, grants, settings and history, including owner identity and every Passkey. Rotate the master key and bootstrap proof, then return to owner setup.
resetPreserved: Installed files, service configuration, Tailscale routes and the original Photos library remain. This does not revoke Apple passwords or macOS permissions.
resetBackupHelp: Accepted operations finish before a protected local backup, reset and restart. The backup contains the previous keys and state.
resetNoRetry: Do not submit again. Completion will redirect to sign-in or setup.
resetWaitExpired: Restart is taking longer than expected. Check diagnostics before retrying.
resetFailed: Reset did not complete. Protected backup recovery is required.
resetRequestFailed: Reset was not accepted. Check your owner session and try again.
resetUnavailable: Reset is unavailable in this runtime.
resetUnknown: Could not confirm whether reset was accepted. Do not submit it again; check service diagnostics or the sign-in/setup page.
